d: Nubs is eager to prove himself to an adult Pooba.
Gekko tries to train a naughty monkey. and hide this from An Yu.
Kwazii, Calico Jack, and Tracker find a nest floating in the water off the eroding coast of the Aleutian Islands. They set out to return the eggs to their mother, but a hungry raven has other plans.

While Bruno helps Diesel with a heavy delivery, Diesel fails to listen to his advice, causing them to both get stuck in Crumble Canyon. Now it's up to the two of them to listen to each other to find a way out.
Ninety puts on a magic show to help the Numberblobs discover who's in the Nine Times
Chef Noodle's restaurant is very popular with hamsters, but when Mittens asks if he has any cat food, he decides to change his restaurant into one that serves food for every animal in town.
No job is too big for a wheel loader. See how they work with Fantus!
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out so Granny and Grandpa Pig are baby-sitting. Peppa and George are put to bed but are too excited to sleep. Everyone has such fun that they exhaust themselves.
Sing along to 'Rock-a-Bye Your Bear' but look! Lachy has fallen asleep. The Wiggles try to wake him up, and they need your help! Next, come and see what Buddy is getting up to at the beach.
Bitzer treats the farmer to a restaurant style dining experience, offering a delicious pie as the main course.
Spidey and Ms. Marvel go down into the sewer tunnels to save TRACE-E, but they discover the Green Goblin is down there!
Evil Pea asks for flying lessons when Broccoli flies her paper plane into her freezer. Evil Pea doesn't let Broccoli know that she intends to fly high to take over Tato Tower.
The SuperKitties teach Zsa-Zsa that if she takes care of planted seeds, they'll grow into fruits and veggies for everyone to enjoy. Lab Rat and Otto drop trash on Kittydale.

Ben and Holly are excited when they learn that Nanny Plum is a Tooth Fairy at night, and go along with her to pick up a little girl's tooth. But the little girl is not so little - she's a human and much bigger than them!
When Flower's fun weekend plans are washed out by rain, Flower leads her friends on a playful indoor quest to gather five rainbow stones, inspired by a tale from Por Por, to stop the rain.
Flower can't wait for Por Por Day, expecting a lazy day of treats, but she's surprised when her grandmother reveals she has a packed schedule planned!
Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars play centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge.
Peppa and her family are visiting an adventure park. Miss Rabbit is in charge, and with her guidance and safety harnesses they have fun working their way around an obstacle course.
It's time for a family game of hide and seek! Everyone hides, while Bluey counts to twenty, but will she be able to stay focused on the game and not get distracted by all her toys?
While on a camping holiday, Bluey makes a new friend called Jean-Luc. Bluey may not understand him, but they find common language playing and hunting for a wild Daddy pig.
Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes get caught in the middle of out of control rolling Coconutdons and tail swatting Pineapplesaurus.
When Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes' yummy drops get snatched by a group of Beetrootsaurus, so begins a game of Pea-in-the-Middle to get them back.
Fergus starts acting strangely when he catches beastly blight. The doctors know the cure but Fergus dismisses their advice in favour of his own muddler traditions.

One of the chickens is laying her eggs. The chick's legs pop out of the bottom of the egg. Oh dear it's a little bit stuck! Wait a minute.the egg is running off! Can the squirrels help bring it back to the chicken safely?
How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What do they do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!
La la la! Fizzy and Suds join a classroom full of kids to write a song, exploring rhythm, nature's melodies, and the science of vibrating strings.

Emma, Takaya, and Auslan Translator Fallon, explore their sense of smell in the Sensational Sensory Space! They make homemade soap with lime and lavender and cook scrumptious sausage sizzles and rainbow veggie skewers.
Learning how to play golf, Wilf and Cornelia compete to see who can hit the ball the farthest. Cesar and Charlie must get them to play more gently before they break everything.

Santi and crew go underwater to stop Escarlata La Pirata before she steals all the Magic Rubies from Giant Clam Reef! / It's a nighttime chase above and below the sea when Escarlata turns the moon into a fish.

Peppa and George are arguing in their room which Mummy and Daddy Pig see as the perfect time to tell them more big news - they are moving house! Peppa then comes up with the great idea to extend their house instead.
Driving along in Mummy Sheep's car, they spot an old van at the Recycling Centre. With the help of Peppa's friends, they make the van colourful!
When Nikhil and Jay realise their parents had two weddings before they were born, they decide to plan them another wedding; the best wedding!
When go-cart day is ruined by bad weather, Millie and her friends create their own race track indoors.
Stan, Grace and Brody form a band, but a mystery drummer joins in somewhere across town. Stan and Gran go on a hunt for their invisible bandmate!
Miffy and Aunt Alice take Baby Bun for his first day at the farm. But suddenly Bun is terrified. What could Bun see as a monster?
Mittens rides along with Fire Chief Grapefruit for the day. But the Fire Chief gets worried when Mittens begins rescuing things from high places, in a way he's never been able to do.
When Mittens and Pants agree to look after Mayor Sourdough's plant, a gift to the visiting mayor, they almost ruin it by caring too much.
Lachy unveils his amazing shrinking spray! But, oh no, chaos ensues when Captain shrinks Wags and himself accidentally. Lachy calls Dr. Jai and Normus for help, will they be able to find a solution?
Today Fantus meets cods, a gull and pollocks.
When Thomas finds a treasure map he creates "The Big Adventure Club," to seek the treasure, but when Sandy wants to join, Thomas says she's too little, so Sandy forms her own club.
Cousin Chloe, Peppa and George pick flowers making daisy-chains and transforming George into a fearsome dandy-lion.
Peppa, George, Rebecca and Richard Rabbit have so much fun playing with the marble run. Though when Daddy Pig joins in, the marble run gets much bigger.
The Farmer wants to turn the tree in Shaun's field into firewood. So the Flock must take desperate measures to stop their beloved tree getting the chop.
When a young Watermelonsuchus gets beached during a heatwave, Ginger and the Baby Pea Rexes have to get creative to work out a way to get the giant baby into the water.

It's the Twin's birthday party and chaos ensues when their little friends arrive. The Wise Old Elf tries to entertain them, but they prove too much of a handful, turning the Wise Old Elf into a mouse.

When Aunty Mia and Aunty Nina need the alley wall repainted, Flower volunteers herself and her friends for the task. Can Flower decide what to paint in time for the grand reveal, even with Flour's energetic help?
Mr. Puppypaws steals royal objects from the museum.
When Barbarito steals Doctora Abuela's ship and traps Santi and his crew, Tina and Abuela must save the day.
Kevin doesn't think he'll ever be top dog; he's not "wolfy" enough to find the legendary bone. With Gekko's help, they both learn it's through caring for others one becomes "top dog".

While caring for sea creatures, Peso discovers an adult Immortal Jellyfish that changes into a baby when it is scared by predators. Captain Barnacles, Kwazii and Peso guard the jellyfish at a distant reef.

The squirrels are helping Duggee in the garden when Tag makes friends with a caterpillar. This caterpillar is very hungry, so Tag feeds her all the vegetable leaves they've been picking. She eats and eats and eats!
The cadets buddy up for their first underwater orienteering adventure, ticking off sea creatures in an epic game of ocean bingo along the way.
Sarah is trying to train Nipper to high-five on command. But when she isn't paying attention, Nipper wanders off and sparks an oven fire with his paw!
When Amma has a tooth taken out at the dentist, Nikhil and Jay want to make sure she gets her first ever visit from the Tooth Fairy!
Ten presents a rundown of the top hit songs in Numberland. Learn number bonds to six, seven, eight, nine and ten with the Numberblocks.
Nim is exploring the Makery today. On her adventures she makes a bug splat picture, a hot dog mummy and a giant snail costume.
Get ready for take-off with Fizzy and Suds. Our bubbles do a safety check with the adventurous pilot, before they take to the skies doing loop-the-loops in his plane!

Emma and Kaeng meet Sara, a police officer with a bicycle! They inspect Sara's bicycle with Constable Maurice, and there's an exciting police rescue mission! Through The Windows, we see more police officers in an animation.
The PJ Masks defeat the Ninjas with ease and become over-confident in their powers, but Night Ninja's secretly plotting to acquire PJ powers for himself.
Professor Kranium hacks into Tom's super-suit to control his movements. Tom must trust his team to save him.
Little J moves out of home - into his very own bark shelter.
While on their Mega World Tour in Australia, Andy and the Band set the kids at Rock Star School a project to unite them, but two pesky Evil Aliens plan to sabotage it.
It's the first day of Pup School. Dodge overcomes his first day nerves as he meets lots of new friends. The pups settle into their class activities with their new teacher Miss Collie.
When Penny plans to donate the restaurant's Lost and Found to charity, Flower sets out to reunite the lost items with their owners before they're gone for good.
With Costa's help and the power of their imaginations, the junior gardeners choose a plant each and paint it across four seasons.
It's a lovely sunny day, so Peppa and her family go to the beach, where they learn all about clouds.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr. Bull's roadworks are in the way.

When Andrew comes home from a day of exploring it seems he lost his favourite toy, Herman the Merman, along the way. He and Dasha race across Hornsby Downs to find him, not knowing that Herman has a magical plan of his own.
The cadets head into the mountains for a daring rescue mission to save rescue dummy Dotty, but along the way, they make a surprising new friend and stumble upon a hunt for pirate treasure!

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: Absorbing Man gains magnetism and threatens Stark Expo. The Iron Friends protect a bird's nest from Swarm's "Paint Bugs" attack.
Shaun comes across some newly hatched chicks who think that he is their mum. He soon tires of the little pests and is determined to get rid of them, but how?
Playing 'Butterflies' in the backyard is great fun, until Bluey runs away with Judo leaving Bingo all alone. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken and Bluey needs to make amends.
Mara visits the clinic with an unusually curly fin but the doctors don't agree on the diagnosis. Can Zog reunite Pearl and Gadabout to work together on the cure?
Eager to impress her Da, Mae sells an umbrella promised to another customer. When things erupt into troll-sized chaos, Mae, proving her troll strength, helps reveal the real problem.
Superbuns has to choose between showing up to her own fan club or helping her sister Blossom, who has lost her very first test tube!
The SuperKitties have to stop Cat Burglar after he takes a gold statue from the Kittydale Museum.
Wizz has an exciting new hobby, and he is desperate to keep it a secret from his friends and most importantly, from YOU!
All aboard the Dad Train! Bingo goes from home to daycare to her job at the Vet every morning, but there's trouble on the lineÂ as a mischievous Bluey throws everyone off schedule.
It takes all sorts, and Hard Quiz Kids is a big bag of liquorice! Vying for Tom Gleeson's Big Brass Mug are experts on pop group Katseye, Collingwood Football Club, sea turtles, and Greta Thunberg.
The Jedi help two bounty hunters work together.
An asteroid heads for earth, with the power to turn our heroes into villains. But help arrives from an unexpected source.

A huge storm in Vietnam sends floodwaters into a nearby cave, trapping Ryla, Kwazii, Shellington and a tiger. Thankfully, a cave-dwelling woodlouse helps them find their way out before the tiger catches up with them.

A storm knocks out power, Thomas volunteers to deliver a generator from Kellsthorpe to Knapford. He's determined to complete this task on his own, but realises the delivery route has complications he can't handle by himself.
The Nine Times Table shows how you can add ten and take one away, to make Nine's friends.
Pants and Popcorn know just how to beat the heat, with a pool party! They invite everyone over, but playing in the water isn't something their friends do.
Have you ever wondered how a road is paved? Find out with Fantus as he sees how an asphalt paver works.

Peppa is excited about her very first ballet lesson and decides to teach Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and George how to dance. She is surprised to learn that Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig know a few ballet moves of their own.
Lucia is on a quest to find her special drumming suit, the one that makes her feel like a superstar, but it's nowhere to be found-not even in the Wiggly Kitchen! Can The Wiggles help her find it?
Bitzer's over-officious management style becomes too much for the sheep who decide it's time for him to chill out. Bitzer's tasks for the day takes on a new purpose, for everyone to have some fun!
When Doc Ock steals the arachno-sting power Team Spidey has to get it back before it puts the town to sleep.
It's the Tin Can Games and Evil Pea wants to win the Tin Can Trophy. She cheats in the final race by putting a magnet on Supertato's back to stop him from going super fast.
Lab Rat creates wacky weather that threatens to ruin the Pawesome Picnic. When the Kittydale Race gets sabotaged, Bitsy stops racing to help the SuperKitties save the day.
King Thistle wants bread for his Royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes Holly, Ben and Nanny Plum to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.
Flower writes a Pet Day 'fun list' for Flour, but quickly discovers that letting him choose his own fun is way better than sticking to a list.
A mysterious song gets stuck in Flower and Flour's heads, and their quest to shake it reveals a special musical bond between Flower, Penny, and Por Por.
Peppa and her family are going on a canoe trip. They hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit and head down river on their canoe adventure.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday. They are staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach.
Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad! But facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots, this will take teamwork.
A quick trip to the shops proves tricky for Dad, when Bingo and Bluey want to play a game of 'Kids'. Now Bluey is Mum, Bingo's her baby and Dad is a very naughty boy.
The Bananaraptors fall into a deep hole and Ginger and the Baby Pea-Rexes must think of a clever and creative way to get them out safely.
Ginger is leading the Baby Pea-Rexes home through a shortcut and gets lost, refusing to admit defeat, she suggests they find an even better bed to spend the night!
Mara visits the clinic with an unusually curly fin but the doctors don't agree on the diagnosis. Can Zog reunite Pearl and Gadabout to work together on the cure?
Duggee's nephew Dudley comes to stay. He's one cute puppy, but he looks like he could cause chaos in the clubhouse. The Squirrels come up with lots of imaginative ways to entertain him!
Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! And grown-up Tag, a firefighter, splashes loads around. Good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand.
With Costa's help and the power of their imaginations, the junior gardeners choose a plant each and paint it across four seasons.
Alex, Rachael and Vanessa, along with Auslan Translator Julia, learn all about the senses of sound and balance. Rachael teaches yoga, they make popping popcorn, and the toys listen to a thunderstorm.
Wilf thinks he's been left out of a picnic, so he sulks and builds a huge tower. The Piggies must convince him to join them before the tower collapses.
After Enrique steals the heart of El Bravo, there's only one person who can help Santi and crew save the day: Tomas's younger sister, Prima Tina!
Daddy Pig is throwing a special party. Everyone is invited, and they are all dressing in scary costumes. Peppa is a witch, George is a dinosaur, Rebecca Rabbit is a carrot gone bad!
Mrs Duck seems to have taken a liking to Peppa's golden boots and runs away with them! Can Peppa track down the golden boots before the big puddle jump competition?
Dance along with him and the Little Tree of Wisdom and then learn about hula hooping! Can you shake your hips and give it a go? And don't miss the remix of the hit song 'The Rattlin' Bog'!
When Jay plays carrom with Ammamma's lucky striker he can finally beat Amma! But when Jay loses the lucky striker his winning streak ends. Nikhil has a plan to help his brother!
Millie, Ben and Maya set out to teach Ying Ying a flying trick for the pet show in the park.
Strange holes in garden fences are popping up all over Porthole and Stink has gone missing! Stan and Gran spy a mystery and decide to investigate.

Miffy's delight at being imitated by Baby Bun turns to frustration when his constant mimicry interferes with her dance recital practice, leading her on a journey to understand the joys and challenges of being a big sister!
When Mayor Sourdough appoints Mittens as mayor of Kibble Corners (just while he takes a nap, mind you) everything goes wrong very fast.
Pants worries that having adoptive bunny parents might not make him puppy enough for a puppy party.
Simon is crafting a floral arrangement for Dorothy the Dinosaur, but his roses vanish when he steps away to get some water. Caterina calls Fiore Enzo, the detective specialist for help!
Today Fantus meets a pigeon, a rat and a badger.
When Thomas borrows Percy's lucky bell for a dangerous delivery, Thomas isn't careful and loses the bell.
When George loses his wind-up robot's metal key, Grandpa Pig uses his metal detector to find it and finds a lot of other things on the way.
It is World Book Day at playgroup but Peppa has so many favourite books she just cannot decide which to go as.
The Farmer is sick in bed, so, with Bitzer playing nurse-maid, it's down to Shaun to handle the daily chores around the farm - with disastrous results.

Split chases a glowing Chillipede into the depths of the Spooky Forest and gets lost inside an overgrown tree-root maze, where the only way out is to follow the sounds of Ginger and the other Baby Pea-Rexes.
Lucy's dad is digging up the meadow and the Little Kingdom is in danger.
When a robotic toy duck is left at the restaurant, Flower becomes obsessed. Meanwhile, Flour the cat struggles to compete with the quacking newcomer for her attention.
When Cat Burglar shrinks Buddy on his way to steal musical instruments, Buddy learns that he doesn't have to be big to be super.
Bonnie's cat tricks the crew into thinking he's a good pirate, but then they realize he's actually after their treasure.
Desperate to prove himself, Gekko recruits Armadylan for extra training.
The Octonauts study a group of baby hammerhead sharks, as they hunt on their own for the first time and poke their noses into trouble.

It's a lovely warm day for the beach. The squirrels learn how to make sand castles. They are doing such a good job that Jon and Nigel the crabs ask if the squirrels could work together to build them a new home.
When Frizzy's dad gets into trouble in the mountains, Frizzy steps up to lead the rescue mission and save the day!
When Dilys overloads a socket at the Cut Price Store and starts a fire, Mandy learns that every job on the Fire Rescue team is the most important job!
When Amma gets the sneezies, Nikhil and Jay are worried that it's Max's fault. They try to stop their cat from being sent away.
Welcome to the game show where you don't count, you see the amount! Join the Numberblocks and learn how to recognise numbers of things without counting them.
Nim makes a sock gobbling monster by recycling an old box. Once the washing is done, she cooks focaccia flowers and creates a puppet mouse out of old clothes.
Fizzy and Suds spend time with some gorgeous country cows and even see them being milked. It's also showtime - and our bubbly friends get to meet some prize-winners. MOO MOOOOO!

Abi and Luke meet Ben, a friendly and helpful nurse! Luke uses craft materials to make his own stethoscope, and Jemima visits Dr Kiya at hospital for an x-ray! Through The Windows, we see more medical workers in an animation.

An animated swash-buckler based on the much-loved children's book written by Julia Donaldson and illustrated by Axel Scheffler. The tale of a greedy rat who craves buns and biscuits, but comes to a sticky end.
Little J is torn between Ms Chen and Nanna's knowledge.
It's time to get back to Rock Star School. But with Evil Aliens, Dinosaurs, Football and Cheesy Puffs, Andy faces a tough task to keep everyone from getting distracted.
Dodge is eager to win the Class Star award, but how will he out shine Cherry the superstar at everything? Dodge discovers that the real key to winning the Class Star award is by trying his best.
Dirk promises to read Flower and Flour a bedtime story but when he's too tired to continue, Flower has to step in and invent her own bedtime story.

Hannah works with two brothers to create a garden that delights all of the senses. Alfie is vision impaired and loves being active and playing, so they create a garden of games he can enjoy with his brother, William.
Suzy's grandma, Granny Sheep, moves into her house for the first time ever.
Peppa and her friends have fun playing with boxes.

Andrew's fear of heights stops him from riding the Lifty Pod - but he doesn't want to miss out on hill sliding with his friends. So, when the littlecorns share how they face their fears, Andrew finds a way to be brave, too.
In preparation for the big Sodor Sings Festival - the biggest musical event on the - the engines are hard at work to make the night one to remember.
Bingo loves horsing around with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.
Winton doesn't want anyone to know about his tummy troubles but Gadabout struggles to keep the news to himself.
While helping at Lesley's bakery, Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing, becoming 500yrs old. A rare four-leaf clover is the only cure, that's if they can catch it!
After reading comics, Buns is convinced a super carrot will give her superpowers. But rescuing her sister Blossom's lost tooth is what makes her a true superhero!
SuperKitty super-fan, Pickles, helps the team save the day.
When Wizz finds a friendly Space Creature on his couch, he has no choice but to try and help her get back to her home before the Fun Suckers find her and put her in space prison.
Jack's the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty's army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat,Â but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.
Rory has forgotten his lunch, again, and the other children have had enough. They refuse to give him any more of their food. Rory is starving and, in desperation, decides to go to the milk bar.
The Jedi look for a legendary creature within the temple.
An Yu feels that something is up and joins Newton and the PJ Masks who are still looking for a way to keep the asteroid and its power of Badness away.
In the aftermath of a fire in the Everglades, Ranger Marsh calls on Dashi & Tweak to help him figure out who stole a Florida box turtle's egg.
Thomas and Percy explore a brand-new track the evening before the route is opened and end up getting stuck in the mud overnight.
One Hundred assembles a Space Division to investigate a mysterious signal.
Mittens and Pants try to figure out the words to DJ Swimfins'; song 'Icky Icky Wah Wah'. But it seems no matter who they ask, everyone has a different idea what the lyrics are.
Join Fantus as he sees a stump grinder in action.

Peppa and George are in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder! Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa decides that she loves thunderstorms. They make big, muddy puddles!
The Tree of Wisdom invites The Wiggles to participate in the Grand Dance Contest!  Get ready to dance, laugh, and cheer - the stage is set, and the contest is about to begin!
Jonathan and Paddington must get their ranger badges but Mr Curry is not happy about having them in house.

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: Tony, Riri, and Amadeus try to fix Howard Stark's failed invention, but it causes chaos at Stark Expo.
Romeo wants to create the ultimate trap for the PJ Masks.
Spin and Ghost-Spider go on a tiny adventure with Ant-Man and The Wasp after the museum is robbed by ants.
Ariel befriends a clam.
Eager to impress her Da, Mae sells an umbrella promised to another customer. When things erupt into troll-sized chaos, Mae, proving her troll strength, helps reveal the real problem.
When a robotic toy duck is left at the restaurant, Flower becomes obsessed. Meanwhile, Flour the cat struggles to compete with the quacking newcomer for her attention.
Peppa and her friends are with their grandads for Granny Sheep's art class. The Grandads struggle but the children help them make art that reflects their favourite things!
It's bedtime and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy! Retracing their steps, Bingo and Bluey lead Mum through their bizzare day in the hope of tracking her down.
When a young Watermelonsuchus gets beached during a heatwave, Ginger and the Baby Pea Rexes have to get creative to work out a way to get the giant baby into the water.
Wearing Bondi's cap, Pounce thinks he's chief lifeguard - but when Gemma and Neville need rescuing from a whale encounter, should he jump in, or alert a real lifeguard?
The trainees help Postal Witch Carryall and his mini-mammoth familiar pass the Pointy Hat test.
Did Mojo and Bo paint road lines going in all the wrong directions? Yes they did!
Andy travels back in time and meets the T-Rex. He tries to find a pumice stone for the national museum.
Teo and Miah see behind the scenes of a gardening show, filmed by the toys! Miah presents a 'What to Wear' weather report, and Teo plays the talented performers on a TV singing competition show.
On a wildlife sketching trip, Norman wants to find the most spectacular creature to sketch, but this gets a bit tricky when Lily Chen tags along.
When a storm keeps the Sprouts from playing outside, Zip thinks the day is ruined! Can his friends convince Zip that playing inside is fun, too?

The Woohoos think a Night-Time Woohoo is calling to them but can't work out where the sound is coming from. They work out that the 'Kerwick Woohoo' sound comes from two Tawny Owls calling to each other across the woods.

t: Guess How Much I Love You
d: It's a fine autumn day and it seems that all of the meadow creatures are out enjoying the sun. Little Nutbrown Hare is surprised that Big Nutbrown Hare knows every single creature in the meadow.
Miffy and her friends get together for Dodgeball club. But Miffy realizes that Ko isn't really a fan of the game.
The Sound Collector discovers an echo in a tunnel, today is a day for musical echoes!
The puppies are playing a game that 'isn't for cats' and Mittens wants to know why she can't play.
MeMo and BaBa realise that spreading a little happiness can make them happy too. Sometimes it's okay not to feel happy and just being there for a friend can help.
The toddlers are visited by a turtle. Fantus helps a little skunk find its parent.
Jack's the new dog at school and the newest recruit in Rusty's army. Jack struggles with following instructions and always forgets his hat,Â but Rusty will make a soldier of him yet.
Fizzy and Suds take us for a ride on a giant radio telescope and discover the Emu Constellation. Let's learn about space together!
Hannah and Zsofi plant a colourful edible flower garden, perfect for a yummy garden tea party.

It's Express Yourself with Art Day! After some 'Hot Potato' fun, Lucia encourages The Wiggles to draw their feelings. Afterwards Lucia shares the idea of displaying their drawings in The Wiggly Art Gallery.

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: Tony, Riri, and Amadeus try to fix Howard Stark's failed invention, but it causes chaos at Stark Expo.
Ranger Nat is stuck at the bottom of the crevice with no way to get up, but the problem grows bigger when Mecha Abby gets stuck trying to save him.
When Sandy learns about a massive shipment of sand that needs to be delivered, she is determined to help despite her size.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy go on a trip to the children's festival where there is singing, making crafts and listening to stories. They stay overnight in a tent, though it looks like it's going to rain.
Peppa and family sleep overnight in a tent and wake up to find the festival is covered in mud. Luckily Miss Rabbit is prepared with lots of muddy activities.
It is a peaceful night at the farm, until Shaun starts to walk in his sleep. The Flock cannot resist their natural instinct to follow, and chaos soon ensues.
Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes go on an underwater adventure inside a rubbery bubble made by a young and friendly Watermelonsuchus, but things take a turn when the Bananaraptors get involved.
Despite protests from the Wise Old Elf, Ben accompanies Holly to her first day at Magic School.

When Por Por's plane to Australia gets cancelled Penny doesn't feel like celebrating Chinese New Year. To cheer Penny up, Flower learns how to make Por Por's famous Moon Cakes, with an imaginary trip to the moon.
When Zsa-Zsa steals other birds' goodies for her Aunt Lola, the SuperKitties must save the Songbird Soiree.
The crew must team up with the fabled tooth mouse El Ratoncito Perez to retrieve his stolen cap and satchel from Enrique.
Catboy wants to increase his speed. but in doing so, drains power from his friends.
When a giant wave hurls Amazon River creatures up into the trees, the Octonauts must get them down safely, without disturbing poison dart frogs who live there.
Duggee and the Squirrels decide to play football. The Squirrels don't know what to do as they've never played football before. Worm, Hennie and Ethel do their best to show them the rules.
Wearing Bondi's cap, Pounce thinks he's chief lifeguard - but when Gemma and Neville need rescuing from a whale encounter, should he jump in, or alert a real lifeguard?
When Gareth takes the kids on a hike for the 50th anniversary of the Pontypandy Pioneers, they end up lost in the mountains and need to be rescued!
The family are having a dancing party to show off their special dance moves, but Nikhil hasn't got one! Will he be able to find an original move?
One goes in search of the legendary One Times Table. Sing along and learn the One Times Table with the Numberblocks.
How does sound travel? In an episode sprinkled with fun, Michelle creates a 'Seeing Sound Sprinkle Sensation' experiment to discover how sound waves travel.
On today's poptastic adventure, Zip's friends are coming to a ceremony for his flower display! Can Zip keep all of his flowers together before the ceremony begins?
When Mayor Sourdough asks Pants to 'watch Nanna Ribbit', Pants didn't think he'd have to chase her around all day, while she goes off on daring adventures.

Abi & Kaeng make a Family Book & introduce us to 'Banksy' & the Banksia family, including their pet dog. They make breath-fresh doggie treats for special guest Roni the dog and Through The Windows, we meet all kinds of pets!
The Tree of Wisdom is here to answer some riddles in the General Knowledge Show! Plus, sing and dance along with The Wiggles to fun songs like 'Hey Tsehay'!
Slurp it up! Fizzy and Suds visit orchards and factories to see how juice is made, explore the physics of squeezing, and create recycled bottle animal crafts.
The dinos gather their toys together to play but Deedee's hopscotch game is torn, Bertie's ball is squishy, and DeeDee's jump rope is too short.
Ginger joins the baby Pea-Rexes on their expedition to find dinner and ends up eating something too hot to handle which alerts the Bananaraptors!
The junior gardeners are worried. Gypsy the dog keeps digging up the yard! With Clarence's help they create a fun and beautiful pet safe backyard.

Andy is exploring the undergrowth on this adventure and he wants you to come along too. He learns to move like a monkey beetle, lift like a leaf cutter ant and even practices some martial arts with an orchid mantis.
When Enrique awakens a giant, Santi and crew must find a way to save the day.
The SuperKitties help Peanut get Nadia's stolen toy car back from Zsa-Zsa.
Duggee is working on an inventory of the clubhouse supplies to plan for the future. What's the future like? The Squirrels wonder.
Bingo loves horsing around with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.
Peppa and her friends are with their grandads for Granny Sheep's art class. The Grandads struggle but the children help them make art that reflects their favourite things!
Peppa and George learn how to talk on walkie talkies.
Promising not to waste a single bite, Mae and Bee find their giant strawberry might actually be more than they can handle, especially with hot sun threatening to turn it to mush!
When a meteorite splashes into the sea Dad and Cosima cause problems by claiming it in the name of science, against the wishes of all the sea creatures.
When the Octonauts all pitch in to help save a sick coral reef, they get some unexpected help from a pod of playful dolphins.
The cadets compete in a series of lifeguard challenges, but Frizzy is distracted by the promise of shiny gold medals.
Zoe learns to embrace her own strengths and celebrate her brother's talents with help from the Super Monsters.
Team Spidey must fix things between Doc Ock and CAL after Doc Ock hurts CAL's feelings.
At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song. all except the mysterious Pretzel.
Strange happenings in the kitchen inspire Flower and Flour to sneak downstairs for a late-night stakeout, only to stumble upon a secret that could lead to the best birthday surprise ever!
Nanny Plum believes she works harder than The Wise Old Elf. The Wise Old Elf believes he works harder than Nanny Plum! King Thistle commands them to swap jobs for the day to settle the argument.
The Piris try to change Brinicle's wasteful ways, but their recycling plan hits a snag.

Broccoli wants to show Supertato her latest art exhibition of jelly sculptures. However, jelly is Supertato's secret fear and Evil Pea overhears, so she knows exactly how she can beat him - with lots of jelly!
Bibi enters the world of The Wizard of Oz, where she meets familiar vehicle friends and goes on an amazing quest to see the wizard himself! Part 2.
Bingo and Bluey want Mum and Dad to smoochy kiss, so they set up a romantic evening for two at their fancy restaurant. Everything goes to plan until Chef Bingo's special arrives.

The Farmer is off on holiday, confident he's left the farm in safe hands. However, the animals quickly learn his replacement is only interested in looking after himself! Dismayed and hungry, they decide he has to go.
Kai faces off against his former friend.
The PJ Masks try and recover a piece of the Evil asteroid from Ivan's pyjamas before he puts them on and turns bad!
Tweak, Paani and Dashi work with a team of fire ants to engineer an escape route when the Paraguay river floods the ants' home.
When a mysterious stink monster blocks the Biggest Adventure Club's path, it's up to the gang to stop him from stinking up Knapford!
Numberblock Three has lost one of her red juggling ball buttons! Can detective Numberblock One help Three to find it by telling the time?
Pants and Popcorn help Mayor Sourdough build the best playground ever by asking everyone what they'd like to have. But in the end, their playground for everyone forgot someone important.
How are fields prepared for crop planting? See a plough in action with Fantus.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive but the car is very muddy. Mummy Pig insists that they clean the car first. Peppa and George help but it turns out to be a very messy job indeed.
It's Lachy and Tsehay's turn to decide what music to play in the Wiggle House today! But while Lachy likes a soothing lullaby, Tsehay likes the energy of techno! It's up to Simon to help them decide.
Drainpipe Dan is on the loose stealing Mrs Brown's wedding ring. Inspector Paddington of the yard is on his trail.

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: When Ultron turns Vision into a baby, the Iron Friends must retrieve the device to fix him.
The PJs need to meditate seriously, but they can't when Munki-gu gets involved.
Team Spidey gets trapped in Sandman's giant sand maze.
Ariel makes a friend.
While helping at Lesley's bakery, Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing, becoming 500yrs old. A rare four-leaf clover is the only cure, that's if they can catch it!

When Por Por's plane to Australia gets cancelled Penny doesn't feel like celebrating Chinese New Year. To cheer Penny up, Flower learns how to make Por Por's famous Moon Cakes, with an imaginary trip to the moon.
After going through the post, Peppa sees a leaflet for Madame Gazelle's flamenco lessons. Peppa wants to learn what flamenco is, so they attend the lesson.
Bluey needs Mum's advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour, when the serenity of her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's growing stable of animals.

Split chases a glowing Chillipede into the depths of the Spooky Forest and gets lost inside an overgrown tree-root maze, where the only way out is to follow the sounds of Ginger and the other Baby Pea-Rexes.
While scuba diving over the reef, Frizzy swims off from her buddy Big Trev in search of hidden treasure and becomes lost underwater.
Ariel learns to stand up to his parents while helping his family's unicorn herd.
Mojo and Bo need to clear out Swoppiton before Preston's smelly sandwich stinkplodes!

Andy travels back in time 152 million years, to the time of diplodocus - a massive 25 metre long plant-eating dinosaur. His mission, to find and pick a giant fern to replace the one he accidentally broke back at the museum.
Michelle and Matt discover how fun it is to be behind the scenes of the theatre! They put on a dazzling puppet show, try on funny wigs and rehearse a ballet with the toys.
When James and Sarah compete for the title of 'best steam driver,' James accidentally spills a burning coal into a pile of wood, sparking a fire.
Aria and Hum argue so much they magically switch bodies! Can they learn to think about each other's feelings, or will they be stuck like this forever?
The Woohoos find new plants which Ellie didn't plant have grown in the veg patch. The Woohoos work out that birds are nature's gardener and sometimes they are, without even knowing it!

t: Guess How Much I Love You
d: Summer in the meadow is a great time to find tasty snacks to eat. Big Nutbrown Hare knows all the best tricks and hiding spots for the yummy treats and Little Nutbrown Hare wishes he was as big and smart as his father.
Grandma accidentally breaks her new beehive and Miffy is determined to help fix it and make it prettier than the original.
The Sound Collector sees the Little Girl on her skateboard. He skates too, but can Mole?
Pants' parents try to get Pants to sit still for a photo. But the energetic, wiggly puppy just won't sit still long enough for a good picture.
MeMo and BaBa discover a dandelion clock and marvel at how a seed can become a beautiful flower.
The toddlers are visited by a mouse. Fantus helps a little gazelle find its parent.
Bingo and Bluey want Mum and Dad to smoochy kiss, so they set up a romantic evening for two at their fancy restaurant. Everything goes to plan until Chef Bingo's special arrives.
Honk! Honk!! Fizzy and Suds visit a truck stop just in time for a bubble bath, they discover that some trucks have beds, fridges and even microwaves in the back of the driver's cabin.
Tammy and Marcus build a Birds Nest Shop for all the local birds to visit and take what they need for their birds nests.
Anthony is ready for a rock 'n' roll eisteddfod, but when he plays a song for The Wiggles it puts them to sleep. It's time to call Caterina, the rock 'n' roll ballerina she will be able to help!

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: When Ultron turns Vision into a baby, the Iron Friends must retrieve the device to fix him.
Zee is ready to launch his rocket into space, but when it takes off, the launchpad breaks and the rocket is launched into the farm instead.
When the trains must deliver in pairs, Thomas is disappointed to be paired with Diesel instead of his BFF Percy.
Grandpa and Granny Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam but when they discover that the birds have eaten them all, they go to a strawberry farm.
It's Grandpa Pig's birthday and the family go out for a celebratory meal. Peppa has never been to a restaurant before.
When the Farmer's niece comes to stay, Shaun and Bitzer soon discover she isn't as cute and adorable as she seems.
During a snowball fight, Ginger and the Pea-Rexes accidentally wake up a Kiwimammuthus from its hibernation and have to tire out the furry beast to get it back to sleep.
After the disappearance of Mrs Fotheringill, Mrs Elf becomes the twin's new teacher.
When Unicorn Cuzzy loses her beanie, her unicorn spark disappears! Flower and Flour chip in to help her retrace her steps and find it before she loses her unicorn-ness forever!
Lab Rat lights up Kittydale in the middle of the night.
With the help of El Guardian, the crew solves the puzzle of their new headquarters in order to unlock a secret treasure.
Munki-gu enchants a Dragon Float, turning it into a menace. An Yu tries to  help the PJ Mask's put this right, but thinks she can't because her powers don't work in the city.
The Octonauts are exploring Antarctica, when Shellington discovers strange microscopic creatures living under the ice.

Duggee and the squirrels had a great adventure outside and want to tell everyone about it. What better way to tell a story than through a Puppet Show! First they make the puppets. Scissors! Card! Glue! Glitter! Feathers!
While scuba diving over the reef, Frizzy swims off from her buddy Big Trev in search of hidden treasure and becomes lost underwater.
When Hannah uses her dad's JoeJet2000 to propel their hot air balloon, she loses control and needs the Ocean Rescue team to get them back to safety!
When Nikhil is too busy to play with him, Jay creates a new imaginary friend. Nikhil makes one up too and they compete to find out which one is the best!
Twenty enters the Pattern Palace to find out who his Twenty-friends are. Learn about number bonds to 20 with the Numberblocks.
Can a car move without wheels? Alex has everything he needs to create a wheely cool car, except the wheels! Join Alex as he learns about friction by turning his wheel-less car into a hovercraft.
On today's poptastic adventure, Helping Hand has crafted a band stand! Can Mae-Mae and her new band work together to write an amazing song?
Pants has a brand new cardboard box to give to Mittens, but wants to keep her from seeing it until he comes up with a great game to play with it.

Andrew & Hunter introduce Banksy's grandparents and Andrew shows us photos of his grandparents kept inside a treasure box! They make a delicious Vietnamese salad and Through The Windows, we meet grandparents across Australia!

Sing along to some classic nursery rhymes with The Wiggles in this episode of Wiggle and Learn! Then play with Caterina, Shirley-Shawn the Unicorn, Tsehay, and the Tree of Wisdom in a game of hopscotch!
Fizzy and Suds explore the art of skateboarding, from how they're made and decorated, to high-flying tricks and safety. Whoosh!

Jacob and Theo are very excited about taking a ride on Collins the Stomper bus. On their journey to Mount Bubble the twins have trouble following the safety rules, distracting Collins and getting the bus lost.
It's so cold in the Valley that the Pea-Rexes risk becoming frozen! Ginger needs to keep them warm and skating around the frozen lake might just help!
Hannah and the kids visit a farm and follow the journey from seeds in the ground to nutritious food in your belly.

Andy is off on an incredible adventure in the middle of the night. Andy heads out on this adventure to meet some nocturnal animals. He runs like a kiwi, jumps like a jerboa and climbs in the dark like a feisty raccoon.
Santi and crew will have to team up with a pirate puppy to stop Bonnie Bones and save an old friend.
Mr. Puppypaws steals Bitsy's favourite toy, Mr. Greenie.
Tino the artistic mouse is trying to paint a picture of Duggee but he can't get it right, which infuriates him no end. As he tells the Squirrels: seeking perfection is his whole philosophy.
At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song. all except the mysterious Pretzel.
After going through the post, Peppa sees a leaflet for Madame Gazelle's flamenco lessons. Peppa wants to learn what flamenco is, so they attend the lesson.
Peppa and her family find a bird on the ground and take it to the vet.
Finding Grand-Mae's magical lantern brings their shadows to life, Bee accidentally creates a bunch of shadow caterpillars that look to eat them out of house and home, literally!
Cosima and Big Lizard are helping Dad train for his astronaut fitness test. When Rex gets in to trouble Dad's hard work finally pays off.
The Octonauts travel up a treacherous river to help a young migrating eel on her difficult journey.
The cadets help Neville overcome a bad case of the wobblies before competing in the Battle of the Boards swimming challenge.
The Super Monsters' car wash becomes a magical mishap, teaching teamwork and responsibility.
Gobby steals Miles and Spidey's powers - and accidentally puts them in Bootsie.
Honey is stuck waiting for Dr Bingo as the other, more exciting injuries get seen before her. Receptionist Bluey tells her to be patient, some of these cases are a real pickle!
Flower is convinced she's cursed with bad luck after breaking a mirror. But with the help of Flour and her friends, she discovers that luck isn't something you find, it's something you make.

King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming and is preparing to welcome him in style. King Thistle is feeling left out. He is a king too!
The Piris find their holiday home double booked by penguin nemesis Millie the Squid.
Whilst Carrot works on Robotato, the rest of the Tato Team go to watch a magician, which is Evil Pea in disguise.

With Bibi in need of repairs, Batgirl takes Bam out for a spin to stop Mr. Freeze's latest icy crime spree. Bam will have to get used to having Batgirl in the driver's seat if he's going to help her stop Mr. Freeze!
The Heelers take a long riverside walk but Bingo's legs are tired and she wants a piggyback. To distract her, Mum and Dad invent fun games and get her little legs moving again!
It's almost time for the ice cream van to pay its daily visit and Bitzer has his heart set on a well-earned treat. However, his work is not done - there's a whole list of chores standing in his way.
The Jedi help Eren search for her missing friends.
Newton, An Yu and the PJ Masks become prisoners of the team of supercharged villains - Who'll save them?
Stranded in an Australian swamp, Peso and Dashi help a flying fox mother and her pup survive the sweltering heat.

With his beloved buddy Boxy rolling on his last wheel, Thomas decides to take on the tremendous task of fixing his friend. With advice from Whiff, Thomas discovers the Four R's reduce, reuse, recycle, and rethink!
It's Numberland's Great Bug Race! One to Four's pet bugs are racing on special tracks, but can they follow the perimeter?
Pants and his bunny dad are going camping - bunny camping. But this year, Pants' dad invites his best friend, Uncle Rocky, who can teach Pants all about being a dog.
No boulder is too big for a rock breaker. See how this machine works with Fantus!

Grandpa Pig picks some vegetables and Granny Pig makes them into a delicious salad. George doesn't want to eat the salad. But when clever Grandpa Pig makes them into a dinosaur shape George eats up everything on his plate.

Caterina leaves twins Dolly and Gigi with her Wiggly friends while she picks up her red Machina. With Lachy, Lucia, and Simon stepping in to help, and Anthony and John adding chaos, what fun will unfold?
It's a perfect, windy day and Jonathan wishes to play kite with his dad. Mr Brown is stuck at home doing business, so Paddington takes Jonathan to the park to play kites.

t: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
d: The Iron Friends team up to stop Swarm and her Slime Bugs from ruining a car show.
The PJs try to stop Munki-gu's shenanigans, but get played by Night Ninja instead.
The Team swings into action to bring back the fun after Electro super charges the amusement park.
Ariel competes in a Happy Patty Clap event.
Mae and Bee encourage their friend, Tiger, a blind witch's cat, to trust his senses and find his lost place in the treetops, bringing the spark back to his magic whiskers.
When Unicorn Cuzzy loses her beanie, her unicorn spark disappears! Flower and Flour chip in to help her retrace her steps and find it before she loses her unicorn-ness forever!

It's Christmas and Peppa is gifted a new puzzle. She wants to make it with Evie but she's still too young. Peppa can't wait for Evie to grow up so she imagines her older and now she can't wait to play with Evie even more!
Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. As they recall all the times he's been a 'Big Teaser', Dad argues that he was 'only playing'.
Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes go on an underwater adventure inside a rubbery bubble made by a young and friendly Watermelonsuchus, but things take a turn when the Bananaraptors get involved.
Camping out overnight on Boomerang Island with the cadets, Frizzy goes on a late night hunt for an alien koala.
The trainees help their friend Ferris overcome her fear of failure.
How can Mojo and Bo win the big race when they have to keep stopping and swopping?
Andy travels back in time 106 million years, to the time of leaellynasaura - a dinosaur that lived in Australia. His mission - to find some broken egg shells from the nest of a mother leaellynasaura.
Rachael and Luke have fun exploring the wonderful world of Radio! They record a song, tell a radio news story and hear a ribbet-ing podcast recorded by the toys.
When Charlie and Bronwyn take the kids on a sailing lesson, Charlie feels upstaged by Peter and a seagull. As Charlie tries to win back the kids' attention, he ends up sinking the boat.
There's a drought in Harmony Hollow, and Zip has the last of the water! Can the Sprouts get it to the animals who need it before a dust storm arrives?
The Woohoos see two crows doing unusual things with twigs and pebbles. They realise the crows are using tools to get food, and this helps them to rescue Iggy's ball and Wynona's hammer.

t: Guess How Much I Love You
d: Little Nutbrown Hare is impressed by Blue Bird's description of a flowery field that looks just like a sea of colour from her bird's eye view.
Boris makes deliveries for Barbara, but his bike has broken down! To help him, Miffy enthusiastically delivers all the groceries in the neighbourhood!
The Sound Collector and Mole find an icy puddle, but it's not only for playing on.
